description: This Java class implements a pre-authentication provider for a security gateway, handling authentication via specific HTTP headers and request parameters, and constructing authorization contexts based on pre-authenticated subjects.

classes.name: PreAuthenticatedAuthenticationProvider
classes.description: A singleton class that provides pre-authentication logic for a security gateway, handling header and request parameter inspection, and constructing authorization contexts based on pre-authenticated subjects.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the provider.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if the request context contains relevant pre-authentication headers.

methods.name: containsHeader
methods.description: Checks if a specific header or request parameter is present in the request context.

methods.name: getRequestParam
methods.description: Retrieves a specific request parameter value from the request URI.

methods.name: tryToAuthenticate
methods.description: Attempts to authenticate based on headers or parameters, returning an authentication result.

methods.name: getPreAuthenticated
methods.description: Extracts the pre-authenticated subject from headers or request parameters.

methods.name: getAuthenticationFailedException
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating failure to authenticate.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string into a list of authorization subjects.

methods.name: buildFailedToExtractAuthorizationSubjectsException
methods.description: Builds an exception for failure to parse authorization subjects.

methods.name: toFailedAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Converts an exception into a failed authentication result.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the authorization context type for this provider.
